rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese expression for food with little nutritional value or excessive sugar, fat, or calories.

example.english: I like eating junk food like potato chips when I watch movies.
example.traditional: 我睇戲嗰陣最鍾意食薯片呢啲垃圾食物。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 hei3 go2 zan6 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 syu4 pin2 ni1 di1 laap6 saap3 sik6 mat6

rows.note: A speaker uses this more formal, written-sounding expression in health, nutrition, or other informational contexts.

example.english: A nutritionist warns that regularly eating junk food increases the risk of obesity.
example.traditional: 營養師提醒，長期食用垃圾食品會增加肥胖風險。
example.jyutping: jing4 joeng5 si1 tai4 seng2 coeng4 kei4 sik6 jung6 laap6 saap3 sik6 ban2 wui5 zang1 gaa1 fei4 bun6 fung1 him2
